note: MiniMax's September 8, 2026 step up from June's M3 — a modest scale-up to 458B/25B (from 428B/23B) under the same non-commercial community license, with the API price moving 0.30/1.20 → 0.35/1.40. The launch table keeps MiniMax's telltale mix: big self-reported gains on the agentic/video rows it cares about (Video-MME, BrowseComp, OSWorld-Verified) plus the now-standard trio of independent rows (GPQA, HLE, IFBench) that land where expected for a 25B-active model. No architecture change; the pitch is 'frontier-adjacent agentic quality at non-commercial-license prices.'
